summary: Navient Solutions, as administrator for SLM Student Loan Trust 2006-5, furnished a preliminary remarketing memorandum covering up to $161,019,025 of Class A-6B and Class A-6C Reset Rate Notes via an 8-K and Rule 433 free-writing prospectus on October 14, 2026. Each class totals $80,509,512.41, priced at 100% of principal, with SOFR-based coupons and a January 25, 2027 next reset date; legal maturity is October 25, 2040. The remarketing, if successful on October 26, 2026, is a routine securitization reset, not a special situation; watch SOFR spreads, subscription levels, and failed-remarketing risk.
